functions.name: patchTab
functions.description: Enables favicons in the panes of a mail or message tab.

functions.name: setConversationDomains
functions.description: Sets the domains assigned to conversations (Message-ID -> domains).

functions.name: getConversationKeys
functions.description: Returns the Message-IDs and References of the given messages.

functions.name: setEventDomains
functions.description: Sets the domains assigned to calendar events (event UID -> domains).

functions.name: clearFavicons
functions.description: Forgets all known favicons so they are requested again.

functions.name: setFavicons
functions.description: Delivers favicons (domain -> data URL, or null if none exists).

events.name: onAssignEventRequested
events.description: Fired when the user chooses to assign domains to calendar events.

events.name: onDomainsNeeded
events.description: Fired when domains whose favicon is not yet known are displayed.
